description: This file defines the TimesheetService class, which manages timesheet data, including creation, retrieval, and workflow permissions within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: TimesheetService
classes.description: Service class for managing timesheet operations, including data retrieval, creation, and workflow permissions.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineService.

methods.name: getTimesheetDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TimesheetDao.

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TimesheetPeriodService.

methods.name: getDetailedTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves detailed timesheet data by ID, including rows and columns.

methods.name: getTimesheetData
methods.description: Processes a Timesheet object to generate rows and columns data for display.

methods.name: createTimesheetByDate
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet for a given date, setting its start and end dates based on the week boundary.

methods.name: extractStartDateAndEndDateFromDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week for a given date based on configuration.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for an employee on a specific date.

methods.name: createTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Generates TimesheetItem objects from input rows for saving.

methods.name: generateTimesheetItemKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for a timesheet item based on IDs and date.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Saves or updates timesheet items generated from input rows.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowsForTimesheet
methods.description: Determines allowed workflow actions for a timesheet based on user role and employee.
